front.title: Decoupled Interconnection of LISP and EVPN VXLAN Domains

abstract.t: This document describes decoupled Layer 2 and Layer 3 interconnection services between a LISP-based VXLAN domain and a BGP EVPN-based VXLAN domain. The LISP-facing border and EVPN Gateway are implemented on separate devices. The Layer 2 service extends a bridge domain through an Ethernet handoff, with independent MAC reachability and broadcast, unknown-unicast, and multicast forwarding in each overlay. The Layer 3 service uses tenant IP transit and prefix exchange through an Interior Gateway Protocol (IGP) or eBGP, with ordinary route redistribution at each border between the transit and its own overlay control plane. IP subnet layouts are deployment considerations; they do not define the service. Subnet-prefix exchange and additional requirements for optional routed connectivity within a common IP prefix are discussed.
